character_description: Prometheus, titan bearing marks of eternal suffering—chains, scars, unbowed spirit. Luminous golden skin despite punishment, hair that seems to contain embers, golden eyes reflecting both compassion and revolutionary defiance. His form embodies resistance to unjust authority.
setting: Mount Caucasus, Olympus, and human civilization transformed by stolen fire
theme: Righteous rebellion against oppressive power for sake of those not allowed to flourish

video_prompts: Prometheus stands in Olympus, witnessing gods hoard fire and knowledge from humanity condemned to darkness.
first_frame_prompt: Prometheus watches from Olympus as humans shiver in perpetual darkness, denied fire and illumination. His luminous golden skin radiates frustration at injustice. Hair containing embers flares with indignation. Golden eyes perceive human suffering clearly—not abstractions but real beings denied tools for flourishing. His chains exist in spirit already, forged by moral conflict.
speech: How can divinity permit such suffering? The fire should belong to all.

video_prompts: Prometheus brings fire to humanity—transformation from darkness to civilization begins.
first_frame_prompt: Prometheus descends to human realm, fire blazing in his hands. His luminous skin illuminates human faces experiencing light for first time. Hair containing embers spreads flames across human communities. Golden eyes reflect human awakening—from helpless creatures to beings capable of shaping their world. The moment transforms everything.
speech: This fire is yours now. With it comes responsibility and possibility.
